## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e` (UI or IndexedDB changes)

## Definition of done

- [ ] Acceptance criteria from the issue are met
- [ ] No real financial data or secrets
- [ ] OAuth scope is still `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file`
- [ ] No deploy was performed
- [ ] Schema changes are versioned, or the schema was not changed
- [ ] `AGENTS.md` is updated if commands, the data model, or importers changed
